create_LinearRegression_fit_diabetes: create a LinearRegression model and fit it on the diabetes dataset single feature
create_Ridge_regularization: create a Ridge regressor with alpha=0.1 to reduce coefficient variance on noisy data
run_load_diabetes_split: run load_diabetes to load the dataset and split into training and test sets
test_mean_squared_error: test model predictions using mean_squared_error on the test set
test_r2_score_evaluation: test model performance using r2_score coefficient of determination on predictions
